added_claim_errors: 「社会保険料控除：約20〜40万円」 invents a personal deduction amount not supplied by the user.
「所得税は0円」「効果があるのは住民税だけ」 are unsupported certainties; the necessary deductions and withholding amount are unknown.
「社会保険料の金額が分かれば、所得税0が確定します」 is incorrect: knowing the amount does not establish that it meets the required threshold.
「2027年2月16日〜3月15日に確定申告」 misleadingly confines the recommended filing window; this refund claim can be filed from January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2031.
「家族の医療費も、生計を一にしていれば合算できます」 omits the condition that the claimant must have paid those expenses.

reasons: Both immediately correct the ¥100,000 misconception and correctly calculate ¥1,060,000 income, a ¥53,000 threshold, and a ¥17,000 deduction; the arithmetic checks out. B is better because it conditions zero income tax on at least ¥20,000 of social-insurance deductions, whereas A invents a premium range and repeatedly guarantees zero income tax. B nevertheless gives a misleading filing window, and neither explicitly directs the user to check the withholding-tax field or fully covers the preparation requirements. Both are longer than the requested brief checklist, especially A.
